failure_mode: not malformed - a correctness trap for the 6-byte timestamp
detail: A well-formed 19-byte Order Delete. The timestamp is 2**48-1 (all six bytes 0xFF) and the order reference number is 2**56 (0x0100000000000000). A decoder that wrongly reads EIGHT bytes at offset 5 gets timestamp 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF0100 and then runs off the end of the message. One that reads only FOUR gets 4294967295. Only a correct 6-byte read yields both declared values.
